thought.text: The issue is my minimal package.json doesn't have dependencies. Let me just add type module to existing file properly:

reasoning_content:
The issue is persistent - the package.json keeps getting overwritten. Let me check what's happening with the node version and see if there's a simpler solution.

Actually wait - the key issue is that the JSON parsing is stripping out ALL the dependencies. Let me check what's happening.

The problem is that the full server package.json needs ALL the dependencies, not just the name/type. I'm only writing a minimal one. Let me try a different approach - just add the "type" line without rewriting the whole file.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Just add type:module without rewriting entire file
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('echo \'"type": "module"\' | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps(d,indent=2))" > /tmp/pkg.json && head -3 /tmp/pkg.json')

# Actually simpler - just sed it in at the right position
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('cd /opt/areloria && head -4 package.json')

# Just directly edit with sed - insert after "private": true
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('sed -i \'s/"private": true,/"private": true,\n  "type": "module",/\' /opt/areloria/package.json')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('sed -i \'s/"private": true,/"private": true,\n  "type": "module",/\' /opt/areloria/server/package.json')

print("Added type: module")

# Verify
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('grep -A1 "private" /opt/areloria/package.json | head -3')
print("\n=== Root package.json ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('grep -A1 "private" /opt/areloria/server/package.json | head -3')
print("\n=== Server package.json ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
PYEOF
